# 文法トレーニング

> 文法トレーニング是面向中文使用者的 JLPT N1～N4 日语语法学习 Web 应用。它通过语法解释、主动造句、AI 批改、个性化计划和间隔复习，帮助学习者把语法用于实际表达。

Canonical website: https://jlpt.meritledger.org/
Interface language: Simplified Chinese
Learning content: Japanese
Supported JLPT levels: N1, N2, N3, N4
Access: Public product information; Google login is required to save learning progress
Pricing: Currently free to use

## Primary pages

- [Official website](https://jlpt.meritledger.org/): Product purpose, core features, target learners, workflow, and FAQs
- [About and contact](https://jlpt.meritledger.org/about): Project identity, scope, official URL, and feedback channel
- [Privacy](https://jlpt.meritledger.org/privacy): Google login, learning data, AI review, and storage practices

## Core functions

- JLPT N1～N4 grammar explanations, connection rules, and examples
- Japanese sentence-writing practice for a selected grammar point
- AI-assisted feedback on grammar, connection, completeness, naturalness, and vocabulary
- Personalized study planning based on target date and daily study time
- Spaced review, progress tracking, and study history

AI feedback can be inaccurate and does not replace a qualified teacher or authoritative JLPT guidance.
